name: brief
label: Morning Brief
description: One page for the start of the day: the weather, today's calendar, unread mail, what the crew did overnight, routines that failed, unread WhatsApp and what Plex added - with a Read it to me button that speaks the lot. Every panel comes from an endpoint the dashboard already has; nothing here is stored.

steps: Open Apps > Morning Brief. Each panel is live: weather (Open-Meteo), today's calendar and unread mail (Microsoft 365, if signed in), the last 24 hours of runs, routines that failed or are overdue, unread WhatsApp, and Plex's recently added. A panel that cannot reach its service says so instead of showing an empty box.
Press Read it to me: the page composes a short spoken summary from what is on screen and sends it to the normal speech path (Settings > Voice). Nothing is spoken automatically.
Refresh reloads every panel. The page also refreshes itself when you open it; it is a snapshot, not a feed, so leaving it open overnight does not poll.
fixes: Morning Brief says mail or calendar is not signed in
That is Microsoft 365, not the brief: open the Microsoft 365 tab and sign in, then refresh. The brief shows the error it was given rather than pretending there is no mail.
Settings > Weather needs a latitude and longitude (the place name alone does not move the point). The weather panel names the failure Open-Meteo returned.
The brief has no Plex or WhatsApp panel content
Those come from the integrations and WhatsApp connectors: check they are connected on their own pages first. The brief never starts a bridge or asks for a token itself.
